note: Wooded drive-in campground in four loops on the edge of the bluff 430 ft above Lake Pepin; trails lead down to the riverbank. Sites are fairly close together, most with good screening between them. --Claude
summary: DNR park data + full ReserveMN catalog: 58 drive-in (19 electric, 20/30 amp), pads 25-62 ft, DNR 53-ft limit, one pull-through; showers/flush/vault/dump/water; campground open year-round; $24/$34 re-read (fees note stripped of permit/booking boilerplate). Not waterfront kept (bluff top, 0.4-0.7 mile to water). Pin ~2 km off (at the ranger station), move flagged; phone added in flags.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. DNR: 'Campground is located on the edge of the bluff, 430 feet above the water. Trails lead from the campground to the riverbank.' ReserveMN tags every drive-in site 'Lake/River/Creek' .4 to .7 mile, none 'Water Front'; imagery shows the loops under continuous canopy. The panoramic Lake Pepin vistas the DNR mentions are in the picnic area, not at sites.
Fit: DNR seasonal note 'Please check the lengths of the campsite spurs. A few of our campsites are relatively small.' ReserveMN pads run 25-62 ft, all 23 ft+, so a 23-ft rig fits every drive-in site.
